source: make a copy 3d of touch football/soccer

image_prompt.text: Painted touchlines and goal lines around the pitch, built so a script can stop play the moment the ball crosses
The centre circle and kick-off spot the ball and players reset to
A goal mouth with posts and net at each end, with a scoring plane inside it
Painted field markings dividing the pitch into halves and penalty areas

layout_placement.text: Out-of-play detection perimeter following the touchlines
Kick-off position at the centre spot, plus reset positions for each side
Goal volumes behind each goal line that register a score when the ball fully crosses

notes: Regulation field specs are fixed, so this is better placed parametrically than free-generated - a P6-lite generator choice, not a routing change.
The prompt writes 'touch football/soccer' as one thing. Those are two different field specs; this build assumes association football because the word soccer is present.

open_questions.ask: Is this association football (soccer) or touch football / touch rugby? The dimensions and markings differ.
Should the pitch sit in a full stadium, a park, or a bare field?

coverage_missing.ask: Which sport exactly - soccer, or touch football? The two need different fields.
Bare pitch, park, or stadium with stands?
Full regulation dimensions, or a smaller casual pitch?

answers.ask: Is this association football (soccer) or touch football / touch rugby? The dimensions and markings differ.
answers.answer: Association football (soccer), with a standard small-sided soccer pitch, goals, and soccer markings.

answers.ask: Should the pitch sit in a full stadium, a park, or a bare field?
answers.answer: Use a simple park setting around the pitch to keep it small and playable.
